session.title: The 3-minute pause
session.description: Settle into your seat and use a few natural breaths to find a moment of quiet.
session.cue: Feel the support beneath you. Let your shoulders soften.
Follow the feeling of your breathing. Gently return to the next breath.
Notice a sound nearby. Let your attention return to the room.

session.title: Listen to your surroundings
session.description: Listen for sounds close by and far away, letting each one come and go.
session.cue: Let your hands rest. Notice the sounds already around you.
Choose one nearby sound. Notice its texture without naming it.
Listen farther away. Allow the sounds to overlap and fade.
Feel your feet against the ground. Take in the space around you.

session.title: A gentle body scan
session.description: Travel slowly from your feet to your face, noticing sensations along the way.
session.cue: Find a comfortable position. Let your hands rest.
Notice the weight of your feet and the contact beneath your legs.
Feel your fingertips, palms, and forearms. Let your shoulders rest.
Notice your cheeks and the space around your eyes.
Sense your whole body. Slowly look around the room.

session.title: A mindful walk
session.description: Take an easy walk along a familiar path, attending to one step at a time.
session.cue: Choose a clear path. Keep your eyes open and take an easy step.
Notice your foot lift, move forward, and meet the ground.
Let your arms move naturally. Return to the feel of your next step.
Slow down and pause. Feel the ground beneath both feet.

session.title: Return to the breath
session.description: Practise noticing when the mind wanders and returning gently to your breath.
session.cue: Rest your hands and notice your natural breathing.
Feel the breath where it is easiest to notice.
When a thought catches your attention, come back to one breath.
Let your gaze widen and notice the light around you.

session.title: Evening wind-down
session.description: A slow body scan with quiet time to mark the end of your day.
session.cue: Find a position that feels restful. Notice the support underneath you.
Move your attention from your toes to your knees, slowly.
Notice your hands, shoulders, and face. Allow them to rest.
Let your attention settle on the rise and fall of your breath.
Listen to a nearby sound and ease back into the room.

session.title: Deep Stillness
session.description: A slow body scan followed by a longer stretch of quiet breath awareness.
session.cue: Sit comfortably. Feel where your body meets the chair or floor.
Move your attention slowly from your feet to your face.
Let your attention rest on the next breath.
If your mind has wandered, gently return to your natural breath.
Notice sounds in the room. Feel your hands and feet.
Let your gaze widen. Take this last minute at your own pace.
